Construct S7 Category Representations, Templates, and Models from Data

Source: R/S7-make-objects.R
new-objects-from-data.Rd

Dynamic constructors that inspect the input type (or family) argument and dispatch to the appropriate family-specific constructor from data.

Usage

new_category_representation_from_data(
  data,
  type,
  category = "category",
  cues,
  ...
)

new_category_representation_template_from_data(
  data,
  type,
  category = "category",
  cues,
  ...
)

new_model_from_data(data, type, category = "category", cues, ...)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing observation cues and category labels. For individual category representations, data must contain observations from exactly one category.

type

Family type string: "UVG", "NIX", "MUVG", "MNIX", "MVG", "NIW", or "EXEMPLAR".

category

Character string giving the category column name in data. Defaults to "category".

cues

Character vector of cue column names in data.

...

Additional model and family-specific parameters passed to constructors. For cognitive models, this includes category_prior (prior category probabilities), decision_rule ("sampling", "criterion", or "proportional"), lapse_rate (scalar in [0, 1]), lapse_bias, Sigma_noise (perceptual noise covariance), noise_treatment ("no_noise", "sample", or "marginalize"), and lapse_treatment ("no_lapses", "sample", or "marginalize"). For specific representation families, this includes parameters such as kappa_0, nu_0, m_0, S_0, c, or bandwidth.

Value

An S7 representation, template, or cognitive model object.

See also

family-uvg, family-nix, family-muvg, family-mnix, family-mvg, family-niw, family-exemplar

Examples

df <- data.frame(
  category = c("A", "A", "B", "B"),
  x = c(1, 2, 5, 6),
  y = c(2, 1, 6, 5)
)

# Create an MVG category representation for category "A"
cat_a <- new_category_representation_from_data(
  df[df$category == "A", ],
  type = "MVG",
  category = "category",
  cues = c("x", "y")
)
cat_a
#> <MVBeliefUpdatr::MVG_CategoryRepresentation>
#>   Category: A
#>   Cues (2): x, y
#>   mu: c(1.5, 1.5)
#>   Sigma:
#>      x    y
#> x  0.5 -0.5
#> y -0.5  0.5

# Create a full category template from data
tpl <- new_category_representation_template_from_data(
  df,
  type = "MVG",
  category = "category",
  cues = c("x", "y")
)
tpl
#> <MVBU_CategoryRepresentationTemplate>
#>   Categories (2): A, B
#>   Cues (2): x, y
#>   Representations (2):
#>     A: MVG(mu = vector(2), Sigma = matrix(2, 2))
#>     B: MVG(mu = vector(2), Sigma = matrix(2, 2))

# Create a full cognitive model from data
mod <- new_model_from_data(
  df,
  type = "MVG",
  category = "category",
  cues = c("x", "y")
)
mod
#> <MVBeliefUpdatr::MVG_IdealObserver>
#>   Categories (2): A, B
#>   Cues (2): x, y
#>   Decision rule: sampling
#>   Category prior: A: 0.5, B: 0.5
#>   Lapse rate: 0 (treatment: no_lapses)
#>   Perceptual noise: none (treatment: no_noise)
#>   Category representations (2):
#>     A: MVG(mu = vector(2), Sigma = matrix(2, 2))
#>     B: MVG(mu = vector(2), Sigma = matrix(2, 2))
